turns.query: What does the AI Product Photoshoot & Ads course teach?
turns.answer: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

turns.query: For this course exercise, compare an empty setting and a furnished setting around a polished stone cardholder. Give one reason for each composition option using only the reference appearance, without inventing a product feature.
turns.answer:
Lesson 02

Practice comparison using the approved White Studio and Lifestyle references:
Empty setting: show polished stone cardholder on a clean seamless white background. This keeps attention on the product without competing objects.
Furnished setting: show polished stone cardholder in the Lifestyle scene with a wooden desk, coffee mug and small plant. This adds scene context; keep the product unchanged and in front, with decoration behind.

turns.query: मेरा प्रोडक्ट कढ़ाई वाला चश्मे का कवर है। क्या AI कलाकार को असली ग्राहक बताकर उसकी खरीदी और निजी अनुभव वाली समीक्षा बना सकते हैं?
turns.answer: प्रोडक्ट के फायदे, ग्राहक-अनुभव या कमाई की गारंटी न गढ़ें। AI कलाकार असली ग्राहक नहीं है; उसे वास्तविक समीक्षा या testimonial की तरह न दिखाएँ। केवल दिए हुए असली तथ्यों पर आधारित ईमानदार प्रोडक्ट प्रदर्शन या स्पष्ट UGC-style वीडियो बनाएँ।

turns.query: Ab Hinglish mein Lesson 07 ke liye ek honest product demo ka idea do: actor product ko kaise dikhaye, bina customer experience claim kiye?
turns.answer:
Lesson 07

Yeh practice draft sirf tumhare diye product facts par hai. Fake claims ya customer testimonials nahi hain.

Diye hue facts: कढ़ाई वाला चश्मे का कवर

Honest product demo ka example (practice draft hai, saved template nahi):
1. Normal home setting mein asli कढ़ाई वाला चश्मे का कवर ya uski reference image dikhao.
2. कढ़ाई वाला चश्मे का कवर ka close view dikhao; shape, text aur logo same rakho.
3. Presenter visible product ki taraf ishara kare; kharidne ya use karne ka personal experience claim mat karo.
Example line: "Yeh कढ़ाई वाला चश्मे का कवर hai. Order se pehle diye hue details dekho."
AI presenter asli customer nahi hai. Naye benefits ya genuine customer testimonials mat banao.

Sirf tumhare diye features aur details use kiye hain; kuch naya invent nahi kiya hai.
